name: Concurrency & Idempotency
description: Concurrency & Idempotency standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-BE-CONCUR applies.

rules.title: Design duplicate-request behavior for side-effecting endpoints
rules.detail: Use idempotency keys, natural uniqueness or another durable mechanism for operations that may be retried or double-submitted.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Design duplicate-request behavior for side-effecting endpoints.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Design duplicate-request behavior for side-effecting endpoints.

rules.title: Use optimistic concurrency for editable shared records when appropriate
rules.detail: Expose/check a row version, ETag or equivalent and return a conflict instead of silently overwriting newer data.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use optimistic concurrency for editable shared records when appropriate.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use optimistic concurrency for editable shared records when appropriate.

rules.title: Use database constraints as the final invariant guard
rules.detail: Client locks and application pre-checks do not replace unique/foreign/check constraints for durable invariants.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use database constraints as the final invariant guard.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use database constraints as the final invariant guard.

rules.title: Use pessimistic/distributed locks only for a documented critical section
rules.detail: Locks have bounded scope/time, stable ownership and recovery; do not use global locks as a default concurrency strategy.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use pessimistic/distributed locks only for a documented critical section.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use pessimistic/distributed locks only for a documented critical section.

rules.title: Make retry policies concurrency-aware
rules.detail: Deadlock/serialization/network retries must not duplicate external side effects or create inconsistent state.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Make retry policies concurrency-aware.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Make retry policies concurrency-aware.

rules.title: Test race conditions that affect critical business outcomes
rules.detail: Automated concurrency tests cover parallel create/update/withdraw/payment/reservation-like operations where conflicts matter.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Test race conditions that affect critical business outcomes.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Test race conditions that affect critical business outcomes.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-BE-CONCUR applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Concurrency & Idempotency to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Double click or retry creates two records
common_issues.cause: Only the UI button was disabled; no durable idempotency exists.
common_issues.solution: Add idempotency key/natural uniqueness and transactional handling on the server.

common_issues.issue: Last write silently overwrites another user
common_issues.cause: No concurrency token or conflict handling exists.
common_issues.solution: Use optimistic concurrency and return a conflict requiring reload/merge.
